definitionAuthority.description: 注册和管理系统中所有可用的 Permission Definition

requirementAuthority.description: Tool / Capability 定义自身所需的 Permission
requirementAuthority.values: PermissionRequirement.PermissionID 引用 DefinitionRegistry 中已注册的权限 ID
requirementAuthority.note: Requirement 不是 Grant；只是声明'需要哪些权限'

grantAuthority.description: 存储和管理已颁发权限授予

scopeAuthority.description: 管理 Scope 定义和评估 (Character / Conversation / Extension / Workspace / Resource)

approvalAuthority.description: 管理 Pending Approval 的生命周期

executionGateAuthority.description: Execution Pipeline 中负责执行权限判定的组件序列
executionGateAuthority.owner: execution.ExecutionPipeline gate chain: ScopeGate → PermissionGate → ApprovalGate
executionGateAuthority.order: InputValidation → Availability → Scope → Permission → Approval → Depth → RateLimit → Concurrency → Idempotency → Timeout → Cancellation → Dispatch

osAuthorizationAuthority.description: OS 原生授权 (Android/iOS/Desktop TCC/MediaStore/SAF 等)
osAuthorizationAuthority.note: OS Authorization ≠ Kernel Permission Grant；两者独立且都为必要条件

fiveConcepts.requirement: Tool 声明需要哪些权限 (PermissionRequirement)
fiveConcepts.grant: 某 Subject 在某 Scope/Condition 下被允许 (PermissionGrant)
fiveConcepts.approval: 当前 Invocation 是否需要审批 (Approval)
fiveConcepts.scope: 权限生效的资源/角色/会话范围 (Scope)
